card.name: Words just before 'start' or 'begin'
card.fires_on: Words right before a likely 'start', 'begin' or 'initiate' (such as 'to', 'usually', 'should', 'restarted'), mostly in dosing advice about starting therapy at a low dose. It also fires on a few general-web places where 'start' comes next.

modes.description: A linking word or adverb right before 'begin', 'initiate' or 'start' in advice on starting treatment, often for elderly patients.
